research_question: On independently generated unseen private maps and cue identities, does label-blind first-two anchor acquisition preserve target-stratified two-step local correction with fewer replay packets than unconditional correction?

independent_materialization.generator: Implement separately from the development fixture and candidate; do not import either to produce or audit rows.
independent_materialization.private_maps: For A and B separately, rank cues by SHA-256(seed|cue|A-map or B-map); first half label 0, remaining half label 1.
independent_materialization.initial_B_error: Rank B cues by SHA-256(namespace|initial_wrong|seed|cue) and invert the first four true labels. The anchor selector cannot observe this set.
independent_materialization.training_stream: Complete 16x8x2x2 A/B cue-action factorial, exactly 512 events per seed. Original index is product order A, B, A action, B action. Sort by SHA-256(namespace|order|seed|original_index) without labels or outcomes in the key.
independent_materialization.anchor_rule: Retain exactly the first two stream events for each A cue; no target, outcome, B correctness, or future stream information is available to this selector.
independent_materialization.late_B_revision: Replace all eight B-local labels with their exact true labels; no ordinary A update follows.
independent_materialization.test: Complete 16x8 A/B cue factorial, 128 predictions per seed, with no test-time updates.
independent_materialization.oracle: Independently reconstruct private targets, selected source identities, old and revised signs, changed-sign counts, integer branch weights, ties, and packet counts for each arm. Do not call candidate fixture, run_arm, CircuitA, or CircuitB.
